bio.text: Ronald Seifert is the Republican candidate for New York State Senate District 21 in Brooklyn in the November 3, 2026 election.
According to his campaign website, he is a lifelong Brooklyn resident and father of two who has owned and operated an NYC-licensed home contracting business for 18 years.

The site says he graduated from Kingsborough Community College and that his earlier work included jobs at Atlantic Express, at DHL at JFK, and with the city's Department of Citywide Administrative Services.
